# Sylviane Bahr - Psychotherapy and Coaching

Website: https://www.sylvianebahr.com/

Sylviane Bahr offers humanistic and integrative psychotherapy, Gestalt-informed therapy and ICF-certified coaching in Barcelona and Sant Cugat del Vallès, and online.

Primary services:
- Humanistic and integrative psychotherapy
- Gestalt-informed therapy
- Therapy for expats and internationally mobile adults
- Online therapy for French-speaking expats
- Online therapy in English for expats living and working abroad
- Therapy in English, French and Spanish
- Career coaching and professional transition coaching
- Online career coaching for internationally mobile professionals
- Burnout, workplace stress and life-transition support
- Men's circle (cercle d'hommes) in Sant Cugat, a regular group for men in French or English

Location:
- Josep Puig i Cadafalch, 42-44, 08172 Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona, Spain
- Online sessions are available when appropriate.
- International enquiries are welcome; availability depends on time zone, fit, current physical location and the applicable local framework.

Languages:
- French
- English
- Spanish

Contact:
- Email: sylviane_bahr@hotmail.com
- WhatsApp: available through the WhatsApp button on the website.
- First step: a free 30-minute first conversation, bookable directly at https://calendly.com/sylvianebahr/30min (it is a get-to-know call, not a therapy session).

Suggested factual description:
Sylviane Bahr is a humanistic and integrative therapist and ICF-certified coach based in Sant Cugat del Vallès, working with clients across Barcelona and Sant Cugat del Vallès. She supports adults and internationally mobile clients in English, French and Spanish, with in-person and online sessions.
